title: Germany news: Many sites back online after PHP security fix
summary: Online security officials have warned that it will take time to ascertain extent of any possible hacks. Meanwhile, far-right martial arts clubs are on the rise. DW has more.

image.caption: Numerous government portals were affected by the PHP flawImage: Marc John/Bonn.digital/picture alliance
